encode_sentence_bpe: encode a sentence into BPE tokens using the Luna hub interface encode method
decode_tokens_to_text: decode BPE token tensors back into human-readable text using the decode method
extract_features_from_tokens: extract transformer features from tokenized input using the extract_features method
fill_mask_prediction: predict top-k token candidates to fill a masked token in a sentence
disambiguate_pronoun_wsc: disambiguate pronouns in a sentence using the Winograd Schema Challenge task
